The plate looks like a paper plate about 20 cm across, which at roughly 240 px wide gives about 0.083 cm per px.

The grapes are mostly red, with one green one. I count about 12 in total. Each is about 25 to 30 px long, or roughly 2.2 cm, so a typical grape weighs around 5 to 6 g. A few of the dark ones are smaller, so I estimate about 5 g on average. That gives about 12 × 5.5 = 66 g, which I round to 65 g.

Grapes are about 69 kcal/100 g.
